x: Bob Plummer, better known for his exploits over the marathon distance, took advantage of the handicapper's generosity to win the handicap by a good margin. Another long marker, Reg Bolem, took second place and John Hilton, a newcomer, made good use of his 9½ mins. start to secure third place.
With Geoff Pearson, now a veteran, gaining 49th place, we were placed 4th team in both the open and Southern Counties race held in conjunction. Also started:- R.
